initiatives.name: PFLAG Tulsa
initiatives.description: A local chapter providing support, education, and advocacy for LGBTQ+ people, their families, and allies in Tulsa. They coordinate mutual aid efforts, peer support groups, and community resources while building networks of care and solidarity for the LGBTQ+ community.

initiatives.name: Tulsa Really Really Free Market
initiatives.description: Monthly free market in Tulsa held on the second Saturday, where people bring items to give away and take what they need at no cost.

initiatives.name: We Do This Together
initiatives.description: Tulsa mutual aid group, formerly Mutual Aid of Tulsa, that organizes neighbors to help each other with survival needs and disaster relief.

initiatives.name: Tulsa Intersectional Care Network
initiatives.description: Mutual aid project led by and for trans, queer, disabled and BIPOC Tulsans. Runs a meal and grocery delivery service and other community care projects in the Tulsa area.

initiatives.name: Cooperation Tulsa
initiatives.description: Tulsa group that runs a community center with a fridge, pantry and closet, plus weekly dinners, skillshares, assemblies and a radical library. Organizes around food sovereignty and mutual aid.

initiatives.name: Tulsa Food Not Bombs
initiatives.description: mutual aid org in tulsa, ok, sharing veg meals/clothes/ gear weekly since 2020
